units.note: καθ᾽ ὅσον … κατὰ τοσοῦτο rendered as proportional ('exactly as far as'); acceptable. Trailing [Cod. Urb. ...] is apparatus, not text.
λήψεται δὲ τὴν ἐπιγραφὴν τῆς μεταβολῆς ὁ δῆμος is idiomatically difficult (the people 'will put the title on / take credit for' the change); current English is a defensible rendering.
Numbers checked: 8,000 (ὀκτακισχιλίων), ten envoys (δέκα), three minae (τρεῖς μνᾶς), nine returned (ἐννέα).

Greek ἐν #2# ἱστοριῶν: the book numeral is an encoding placeholder in the source text and cannot be read here; English 'in his Histories' omits the book number rather than inventing one. No fix proposed.
